intro.title: useDeferredValue
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple search input component that demonstrates how to handle slow, expensive updates without blocking the user interface. You will learn the core concept of deferred values, which allows you to delay rendering non-urgent updates while keeping the app responsive. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactivity system and the `useDeferredValue` function from Vue's Composition API. By the end, you'll understand how to implement this pattern to improve performance in real-time user interactions like filtering or searching.
intro.usecase: In real applications, useDeferredValue helps maintain responsive interfaces during intensive UI updates. You'll see this pattern in dashboard applications where complex data visualizations render while keeping user interactions like filtering smooth. Search interfaces with live results benefit from deferring expensive calculations until after user input settles. This approach prevents janky typing experiences in forms with real-time validation or auto-suggestions, ensuring the UI remains interactive even during heavy rendering work.
